group_assessment.weighting: A single-patient case report (18-month-old boy, consanguineous parents) with a novel homozygous SLC18A2 canonical splice-acceptor variant classified likely pathogenic on PVS1, PM2 and PP4 plus SpliceAI; no RNA study and no CSF neurotransmitter analysis. Treatment response is clinical observation without rating scales or video. The authors disclose language editing with a generative-AI tool. No WWOX content; its value is the diagnostic pattern (oculogyric crises read as seizures, normal MRI, normal EEG during events).

entries.proposition: The proband's events were first treated as seizures; video-EEG captured one event with no epileptiform activity.
entries.snippet: Video‐EEG captured one event and demonstrated no epileptiform activity, confirming a nonepileptic movement disorder.

entries.proposition: CSF neurotransmitter analysis was discussed but not performed, because of parental reluctance.
entries.snippet: Analysis of cerebrospinal fluid neurotransmitters was discussed but not performed due to parental reluctance.

entries.proposition: The Introduction states routine CSF HVA and 5-HIAA are usually normal in PKDYS2.
entries.snippet: Notably, routine cerebrospinal fluid neurotransmitter levels (HVA, 5‐HIAA) are usually normal in PKDYS2, distinguishing it from other monoamine disorders [3].

entries.proposition: The variant was classified likely pathogenic from a canonical splice-acceptor location (PVS1), absence from population databases (PM2) and phenotype (PP4), with SpliceAI support and no RNA study.
entries.snippet: Although functional RNA studies were not performed, the variant affects a canonical splice acceptor site and SpliceAI predicted loss of the native splice acceptor site (DS_AL = 0.74), supporting a loss‐of‐function effect.

entries.proposition: Brain MRI and the routine metabolic screen were normal.
entries.snippet: Brain MRI and routine metabolic screens (including amino acids, urine organic acids, lactate, and ammonia) were normal.

entries.proposition: Levodopa-benserazide was stopped because adverse effects (irritability, hyperactivity, sleeplessness) outweighed an initial slight gain in head control.
entries.snippet: Because these adverse effects outweighed any benefit, levodopa was discontinued.

entries.proposition: The authors state absence of rating scales and of video as limitations of the response assessment.
entries.snippet: A limitation of this report is the absence of standardized quantitative rating scales for assessing the severity of dystonia and parkinsonism before and after treatment

entries.proposition: Genotype-outcome contrast quoted from a cited cohort: 9 of 17 with p.Pro237His died by age 13, all 14 with p.Pro387Leu survived.
entries.snippet: In Saida et al.’s series, 9 of 17 patients with Pro237His died by age 13 years, whereas all 14 patients with Pro387Leu survived [1].

entries.proposition: A generative-AI chat tool was used for language editing.
entries.snippet: used ChatGPT (Version 4) solely for language editing of the manuscript
